ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is amended by changing all of the M1-2,
Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District symbols and indications as shown on Map
No, 20-C in the area bound by:

South South Chicago Avenue; South Jeffrey Boulevard; East 83" Street; the northeast
right-of-way line of the Pennsylvania Railroad; and a line 141.26 feet northwest of East
83" Street and South South Chicago Avenue intersection as measured along the west
line of South South Chicago Avenue,

to those of a RS-3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Dhl dfome

Michelle Harris
Alderperson, 8" Ward

Common Address:
8276 S. South Chicago Avenue
